mods.name: Veganism
mods.description: Entities react to being hit and take revenge, animals scream and summon the Spirit of the Animals, and eating meat is punished by the Veganism effect. Supports Russian and English.

releases.notes:
# 🌿 Veganism 1.1.0                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  A chaotic, lore-driven survival mod where the animals fight back. Kill too many of them and you summon the **Spirit of the Animals** — a custom Wither boss that curses you with **Veganism**, after   
  which eating meat makes you violently sick.                                                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  > ⚠️ This is a **survival** mod. In Creative (or with cheats) the player is invulnerable and mobs ignore you, so the mechanics won't trigger — the mod will warn you in chat.                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  ## ✨ Features                                                                                                                                                                                          
  - **Animal Revenge** — kill any mob and nearby mobs hunt you down, dealing damage on contact, with particles and angry chat lines.                                                                     
  - **Screaming animals** — slain animals scream with a burst of red particles.                                                                                                                          
  - **Spirit of the Animals** — kill enough animals and a custom Wither boss spawns, locked onto you. It drops oak leaves + farm animals on death — **no Nether Star** — and gives reduced XP.           
  - **The Veganism curse** — the Spirit's skulls are weakened and block-safe, but inflict **Veganism**. While cursed, eating meat gives no hunger back — only **Nausea + Hunger**. **Milk won't cure     
  it.**                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - **Vegan bonus** 🆕 — go long enough without meat (default 5 min) to earn a **Clean Conscience** buff (Regeneration + Speed).                                                                         
  - **Advancements** 🆕 — a full 6-goal advancement tab, localized in **English & Russian**.                                                                                                             
  - **Adaptive language** — all text auto-switches between **English and Russian** based on your game language (overridable in settings).                                                                
  - **In-game config** — full Cloth Config GUI via **Mod Menu** or the `/prop` command.                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                         
  ## 📦 Requirements                                                                                                                                                                                     

...
